one_line_description: Freshdesk is a customer service software that offers AI-powered features, including chatbots, automation, and analytics.
auth_notes: Freshdesk offers various authentication methods, including OAuth2, API key, basic authentication, bearer token, and JWT.

evidence.quote_snippet: From your first AI agent to AI across customer service.
The API uses API key-based authentication, and each request must include the API key in the request header.
One deployment can serve multiple Freshdesk accounts with credentials supplied per request.
64 tools and 2 prompts through Model Context Protocol: tickets, conversations, contacts, companies, knowledge base, and custom fields in natural language.
